implementation_correction.observed_error: Astropy spherical_offsets_to rejected the ICRS Gaia SkyCoord because it carried an obstime attribute while the ICRS center did not.
implementation_correction.change: Remove the obstime frame attribute from the already numerically epoch-propagated Gaia ICRS coordinates. The ra_epoch and dec_epoch numbers, catalog selection, image preparation, source detector, matcher, RANSAC, WCS fitter, thresholds and gates are unchanged.

purpose: Fit an independent full-field Gaia DR3 WCS for each passed V19AG B/R/I active mosaic before any cluster-member coordinate, member cutout, deblending, photometry, mass, current, lensing, halo or gravity input is opened.

gaia_selection.epoch_rule: Linearly propagate every retained Gaia source from its DR3 ref_epoch to the FITS DATE-OBS Julian year. Gaia pmra is mu_alpha*cos(dec), so the RA angle change is pmra/cos(dec). Parallax and perspective acceleration are not applied.
gaia_selection.selection_boundary: Gaia selection uses only foreground-star astrometric quality and brightness; it has no cluster-member, image-residual or physics-dependent term.

image_preparation.member_or_candidate_mask: none; the central 90 arcsec is excluded geometrically for all filters before matching, independent of any member catalog

algorithm.initial_center: Use CRVAL1/CRVAL2 from each source FITS header at the geometric active-mosaic center; do not recenter on the cluster light.
algorithm.initial_scale: Use the absolute mean of CDELT1/CDELT2 in each source FITS header.

outputs.wcs: one JSON WCS header per filter
outputs.matched_stars: one CSV of Gaia source IDs, propagated coordinates, image coordinates and residuals per filter
outputs.diagnostic: one residual-distribution PNG; no science-image or member cutout is emitted

claim_boundary: V19AH can establish a foreground-star WCS and cross-filter registration for the V19AG full frames.

It cannot establish a PSF, saturated/vignetted science mask, photometric zeropoint, deblending rule, member flux, member color, stellar mass, baryonic current, lensing prediction or gravity prediction.
The earlier Chandra Gaia cone is reused only as an independently frozen foreground-star catalog; no X-ray coordinate, source match or shock result is opened.
Failure is an astrometric data-preparation failure, not a failure of Sigma Gravity. A pass authorizes a separately frozen full-field mask and Gaia-star PSF audit.
